subject: Accelerated onboarding credit + tiered rev-share framework for Brightline Labs
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@brightline.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership commercial - Brightline x Redwood (intro)

Hi Priyom / Camila,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team at Brightline is excited about a go-to-market partnership. I promised to put some high-level commercial thoughts on paper so we can start the legal/finance loop. Attached a short intro deck for context (Brightline_IntroDeck.pdf).

High-level ask from our side:
- Standard reseller / referral arrangement for our integration launches.
- A starter onboarding credit to help us accelerate the first 3 pilot customers (covers integration support & co-marketing).
- A rev-share split for closed ARR tied to introductions from Brightline.

Can you share what frameworks you typically use for: onboarding credits, lead registration windows, and commission cadence? We have internal goals to close first pilots by end of Q2.

Appreciate it — cc'd our contracts lead (contracts@brightline.com) for the loop.

Best,
Alex Mercer
Head of Partnerships
Brightline Labs

Attachment: Brightline_IntroDeck.pdf (6 slides, outline of integration and pilot customers)

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@brightline.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial - Brightline x Redwood (intro)

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the demo. Excited to partner.

High level framework we propose to accelerate pilots (we can iterate with legal/finance):

1) Introductory onboarding credit
- One-time onboarding credit: $10,000 (applied against Brightline's first invoice).
- Purpose: co-marketing, integration engineering, and enablement support.
- Credit is refundable only by deduction from first invoice (i.e., not cash refundable).

2) Rev-share / referral commission
- Rev-share on ARR sourced by Brightline: 20% of Redwood net ARR for first 12 months after customer go-live, then 12% thereafter.
- Commission paid quarterly, calculated on billed net (post discounts/returns).

3) Early-bird incentive
- If partner signs commercial MA by 2027-05-01, add +5% uplift to the first-year rev-share for deals introduced in first 90 days post-signature.

4) Lead registration
- 90-day registration window from initial intro. Co-sell/hand-rolled deals reviewed on a case-by-case basis with Sales Ops.

Attached two artifacts to illustrate operational flow: Intro_Credit_Workflow.drawio and Opportunity_Playbook.md.

Next steps: could you confirm whether Brightline requires exclusivity, and whether your legal team prefers onboarding credit to be refundable in cash vs credited to first invoice? If ok, we will route a short MA + rev-share appendix to legal.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Intro_Credit_Workflow.drawio, Opportunity_Playbook.md

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal - Brightline commercial proposal & asks (please review)

Team — consolidating the proposal so we can move Legal/Finance quickly. Note: Alex asked for fast turnaround; Brightline expects pilots in Q2.

Proposal summary (for review with approvals annotated):
- Onboarding credit: $10,000 (credit against first invoice) — ask Finance if this is acceptable (Marissa)
- Rev-share: 20% Y1, 12% Y2+ (paid quarterly on net billed) — ask Sales comp/RevOps to confirm commission mapping (Karthik)
- Early-bird: +5% uplift to Y1 rev-share for deals introduced within 90 days if MA signed by 2027-05-01 (note: limited window)
- Lead reg: 90-day window; exceptions for co-sell with evidence (signed SOW or joint pipeline email)
- Exclusivity: Brightline asked for 6-month regional exclusivity — recommend we decline and offer a preferential early access instead.

Operational asks: 
- Marissa: can Finance accept credit applied as invoice deduction rather than cash payback? Any tax/recognition flags?
- Karthik: if we pay partner rev-share, does that map to existing partner comp plans or require a special ladder? Also confirm timing for payout (net-30 after invoice settlement).
- Camila: any concerns about customer success handoffs for pilot customers?

If everyone is comfortable, I'll send a counter with suggested contract language and routing to Brightline legal.

Thanks — quick replies appreciated.
Priyom

[Internal note: keep partner friendly; pilots are strategic for our integration marketplace]

From: contracts@brightline.com
To: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex@brightline.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@brightline.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial - Brightline x Redwood (intro)

Priyom — thanks for the clear summary. Our legal team had a look and attached a marked-up MA + rev-share appendix (Brightline_MA_RevShare_Draft_v2.pdf). A couple of redlines to flag up-front:

- Onboarding credit: we prefer a non-refundable onboarding fee to avoid clawbacks; suggest making the $10k non-refundable and applied to onboarding activities.
- Exclusivity: we are asking for 6 months of exclusivity in North America for the specific verticals listed in Section 2 of the draft.
- Payment timing: we requested 60-day payment terms for partner commissions citing internal pay cycles.

On commercial points, we're broadly aligned on percentages but want to ensure the early-bird uplift is available for introductions that are active pipeline (not cold intros).

Please see attached for the exact redlines. Happy to hop on a quick call this week to resolve open points.

Best,
Contracts Team
Brightline Labs

Attachment: Brightline_MA_RevShare_Draft_v2.pdf

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: contracts@brightline.com, Alex Mercer <alex@brightline.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial - Brightline x Redwood (intro) — counterterms and next steps

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. We've reviewed your redlines and propose the following compromise to keep timelines for Q2 pilots intact:

- Onboarding credit/fee: Redwood proposes to keep the $10k as a credit applied to Brightline's first invoice (non-cash refundable) but convert language to allow claim of unused credit for agreed deliverables only — this protects both sides. We'll reflect as a credit rather than an unconditional refund.
- Exclusivity: we cannot commit to regional exclusivity. Instead we will offer a 45-day preferential lead review window and an annual pilot priority slot for agreed verticals.
- Payment timing: we can accept 45-day payout terms for commissions (midpoint between your 60 and our standard 30).

Attached: Redwood_Counterterms_20270410.pdf (highlights are inline). If this works, happy to have Legal trade redline for signature. If not, propose a 30-minute call Tuesday 2027-04-12 to close.

Next steps: 
- Alex: please confirm internal signoff on the above compromises.
- Camila / Marissa: if fine, I'll route to Legal with the countertracked doc.
- Karthik: confirm comp mapping once Legal aligns on final payment cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.
Priyom Das
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Counterterms_20270410.pdf
